_sceneweaveEvidence.attachmentPolicy: Every original reporter JSON and inline body is retained. Final C5 and failing-test attachments are content-addressed; other cohort external bytes retain actual local source path/hash/size. Traces are retained only for failures, without duplicated trace copies.
